actions.findings:
Bounded rationality provides a theoretical framework for decision-making and planning under resource limitations using information-theoretic ideas. [source-28b66dc2c66f4bd9]

Cultural transmission acts as a domain-general mechanism enabling agents to acquire behavioral dispositions and information in real-time. [source-41ed1f7cd5c74426]
actions.limitations: Findings rely on theoretical models of bounded rationality and cultural learning, requiring empirical validation in open-ended deployment contexts.
actions.next_questions: How do multi-agent coordination frameworks scale when agents attribute moral responsibility dynamically?
